versions.changelog:
- Introduced experience-driven procedures: workflows now auto-evolve from failures and adapt based on user feedback.
- Added two new scripts: mengram-feedback.sh for recording workflow outcome (success/failure with context), and mengram-procedures.sh for listing and inspecting all learned procedures.
- Procedures now support automatic version history and evolution logs, with feedback triggering improvements.
- Updated documentation to reflect new feedback and procedure management features.
- Enhanced guidance on when to provide feedback and how to interact with self-improving workflows.

- Removed the requirement for the MENGRAM_USER_ID environment variable. Now only MENGRAM_API_KEY is needed.
- Updated documentation (README.md, SKILL.md) to reflect simplified configuration and environment requirements.
- Improved setup and usage instructions for easier onboarding.

Initial release: Adds long-term memory to agents with semantic, episodic, and procedural recall.

- Supports storing and searching user facts, events, and workflows across sessions and channels.
- Provides Bash scripts for searching memory, saving new information, getting user profiles, tracking workflows, and verifying setup.
- Enables context-aware and personalized responses by always recalling memory before answering personal or historic questions.
- Designed for easy configuration and secure handling of user data using environment variables and external API.
- Includes clear usage guidelines and examples for integrating memory features into agent behavior.
